comment: Round 22 — event-kind ↔ LatticeKind dispatch consistency vectors per spec event-kind-registry.json + soland/src/reducer/lattice_kinds.rs::default_lattice_registry. Validates that the spec event-kind registry's (event_kind, cell_family, lattice, bottom) tuples are coherent: (a) every active reducer-input durable kind that declares cell_family also declares a single lattice in the core set {or-set, mv-register, cas-register, fsm, counter, ordered-log}; (b) any single cell_family is bound to exactly ONE lattice across ALL kinds that declare it (no cell_family in two lattices); (c) cell_family namespace prefix is `ck.component.`; (d) bottom ∈ {reject, expose}; (e) the aggregate cell-family set covers the spec-mandated families used by Move/Anchor pipeline. Cross-checks the LIVE event-kind-registry (not a frozen snapshot). The validator is structural — does not run dispatch — and complements `validate_event_kind_registry` by surfacing the same-cell-family/different-lattice drift loudly. Pattern mirrors `discovery_profile_fixture` and the Round-21 anchor_view_compaction approach: the fixture declares EXPECTED canonical lattices per cell-family AND the validator confirms the live registry matches. Drift from either side fails loudly.

expected_cell_family_lattice_bindings.comment: Canonical lattice per cell-family. Mirrors the LIVE event-kind-registry.json exactly. soland/src/reducer/lattice_kinds.rs::default_lattice_registry may add SDK-side families ahead of the spec; once those land in the spec registry they MUST be added here. Future spec drift surfaces here as a hard failure.

expected.rationale: Every active+reducer_input+durable_event kind that declares cell_family MUST also declare a `lattice` field, and that lattice MUST be in the core set. Mirrors `validate_event_kind_registry` M11 invariant; this vector is the dual.

If two distinct event_kinds declare the same `cell_family` they MUST also declare the SAME `lattice`. A cell-family bound to two lattices is a wire-model drift bug — the receiver cannot dispatch to a single LatticeKind impl.
Every cell_family MUST start with `ck.component.`. Non-conforming families would not match any LatticeKind impl in `default_lattice_registry`.
Every reducer-input durable kind that declares cell_family MUST set bottom ∈ {reject, expose}. `reject` quarantines the cell on Bottom; `expose` surfaces multi-value to UX.
Every family in `expected_cell_family_lattice_bindings.or_set_families` MUST resolve to lattice=or-set in the live event-kind-registry. Drift from either side ⇒ fixture failure.
Every family in `expected_cell_family_lattice_bindings.cas_register_families` MUST resolve to lattice=cas-register in the live event-kind-registry.
Every family in `expected_cell_family_lattice_bindings.fsm_families` MUST resolve to lattice=fsm in the live event-kind-registry.
Per-issuer monotonic append families. Bottom ⇒ replay-protection rejection (duplicate issuer_seq).
Concurrent multi-value families. Bottom=expose so UX renders both candidates.

lww-register / rga are extension-only lattices restricted to ui_affordance/content/draft/cosmetic cells via ck.profile.collaborative_text.v1. A reducer-input durable kind in the registry MUST NOT declare these as its lattice.
Spec mandates cell_family starts with `ck.component.`. Any other prefix is a registry drift bug.
Bottom mode must be `reject` (quarantine cell on Bottom) or `expose` (surface multi-value). `ignore` would silently drop conflicts — not allowed.
